triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol` save door, with a possible spec half for the entry shape) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:build (writing metadata) · Bug · the save door's `422 INVALID_METADATA` entries keep only `{path, message, code: 'custom'}`, so a spec refusal code carried on a zod issue's `params.code` (here `CONTROLLED_BY_PARENT_MASTER_INVALID`) never reaches the client. Studio and agents cannot localise or act on the specific refusal. A wire change, so it needs a `Metadata-protocol:` line and changeset. Found on PR #36579 (#36526) → p2 · size S. On request from repo:objectstack#2 (#32588 comment 7089058780).

Shipped in #37962, merged as `c23e5568e9cf2619e446d91fb8ec2ecd8f86beb5` (2026-11-27 15:06Z).

The save door's `422 INVALID_METADATA` `issues[]` entries now carry the registered refusal on `params` (read `params.code`, e.g. `CONTROLLED_BY_PARENT_MASTER_INVALID` beside `params.shape`). The entry's own `code` stays `'custom'`. Only a code `ErrorCode` accepts is forwarded, with string, finite-number and boolean members only. `_diagnostics.errors[]` and `seedApplied.issues[]` keep exactly `path` / `message` / `code`.

Records: os-dev-report 7220229156 (round 2), contract review FAIL 7219293041 then delta PASS 7220382968, L1 REWORK 7219317393 then L1 ACCEPT 7220889076, landing 7220960592. Nits N5 (per-code allow-list for sibling params) and the `failed[].issues` read at `protocol-history-and-publish.ts:2654` were left as follow-ups at most; not filed.
